text: Be selfish for the next three years.
Go put your own oxygen mask on.
Put some money in the bank.
Be greedy on the amount of money you want to make.
Because if you go all in, if you stop thinking, I wish I could do more, be more.
Go all in and make the money.
And what you can do in five years from now, what you can do in seven years from now, what you can do in 12 years from now is unbelievable.
